services.title: Choose a service
terms.title: Booking terms
terms.p1: A €15 deposit is required for every booking. It is deducted from the total price; with a YehMee gift voucher no deposit is needed. The rest is paid on site in cash or by card.
terms.p2: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 48 hours in advance. After that, the deposit is not refunded. If you are more than 10–15 minutes late without letting us know, the treatment may be shortened or the appointment rescheduled.
